subject: Medford Armory Emergency Restoration Funding
overview: The committee recommended $37,280 in Community Preservation Act funding for emergency masonry restoration at the Medford Armory. Members also reviewed the FY26 Annual Plan and discussed establishing new guidelines for historic preservation projects on private property.

items.title: Medford Armory Emergency Building Restoration
items.summary: Approved a recommendation for $37,280 in funding for emergency masonry repairs at the Medford Armory. The approval included conditions requiring historically accurate mortar matching and a commitment to host at least one annual public event at the site for ten years.

items.title: Guidelines for Private Building Preservation
items.summary: Discussed the need for specific criteria and more stringent guidelines when using public funds for historic preservation projects on privately owned buildings. The committee decided to schedule a formal discussion on this policy for the January meeting.

items.title: Affordable Housing Trust Coordination
items.summary: Discussed the working relationship with the Affordable Housing Trust and a forthcoming community meeting on the trust's action plan. A dedicated discussion on aligning CPA funding with trust activities was scheduled for September.

items.title: FY26 Community Preservation Plan Update
items.summary: Reviewed and edited the draft annual plan, including updates to financial summaries, environmental justice mapping, and program area goals. The committee amended the historic preservation priorities to favor projects that provide functional community use over general awareness or character.

items.title: CPA Temporary Signage
items.summary: Selected a new design for temporary project site signage that includes QR codes to provide the public with direct links to project information and the committee website.

items.title: Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the meeting held on June 10.
